title: Financial Document Intelligence - RAG Field Extraction Spec (Retrieval-Oriented)
description: Module-wise extraction schema for a company's annual report, organized for retrieval. Each module maps to one or more Retrieval Units - a single contiguous section of the report (a primary statement, a note, or a front/back-matter block). The retrieval layer locates and fetches a unit ONCE; every field in that unit is then answered by the LLM from that same shared context. This is the retrieve-once / extract-many pattern, so a full extraction run performs ~17 retrievals (one per unit) instead of one per field.

reference_document.note: Example values come from this report; the schema, queries and locators are company-agnostic and reusable.

retrieval_model.concept: Retrieve-once, extract-many. Retrieval is per Retrieval Unit (≈17 units), not per field (200 fields).
steps: 1. LOCATE each unit: match locator_keywords (and statement_type / note references) against the document to find the page-range / note number.
2. RETRIEVE once per unit: embed retrieval_query and run hybrid (vector + graph + keyword) retrieval, scoped to the located pages, to gather the unit's context.
3. EXTRACT fields: pass the shared unit context + each field's extraction_prompt to the LLM. Every field returns value + source + confidence.
4. NORMALIZE & VALIDATE: apply each field's normalization, check data_type, and run the unit's validation.rules (totals must reconcile).
retrieval_model.period_convention: Dual-period fields (periods = [current, comparative_prior]) must return BOTH years as {current: <num>, prior: <num|null>}.
retrieval_model.units: All monetary amounts are in INR Lakhs unless a field states otherwise.

scope_legend.primary_statement: A primary financial statement (Balance Sheet / P&L / Cash Flow) printed as a table on consecutive pages.
scope_legend.note: A note to the financial statements (detailed breakdown behind a statement line).
scope_legend.front_matter: Front-of-report disclosure: cover, Corporate Information, General Information.
scope_legend.back_matter: Independent Auditor's Report, Secretarial Audit, and other back-of-report sections.

output_contract.value: The extracted value normalized per the field. Dual-period fields return {current, prior}. Null / empty list if the value is not present in the unit context.

source.page: 1-based page number(s) the evidence came from
source.note_no: financial-statement note number, if the value came from a note
source.statement: which statement/note the value belongs to (e.g. BS / PL / CF / note 12)
source.snippet: verbatim supporting text / row from the document
source.evidence_ids: ids of the retrieved graph nodes / embedding chunks used to answer

retrieval_units.title: Balance Sheet
retrieval_units.retrieval_query: Standalone Balance Sheet as at the reporting date: non-current assets, current assets, total assets, equity, non-current liabilities, current liabilities, total equity and liabilities - current year and prior year in Lakhs
retrieval_units.context_hint: The standalone Balance Sheet table (usually 1-2 pages), with its linked Other Equity / Reserves note for the line-item breakdowns. Share capital detail and trade receivables gross/ECL are covered by their own dedicated Retrieval Units (RU_SHARECAP, RU_TR) -- not duplicated here.

rules: Total non-current assets + Total current assets must equal Total assets.
Total equity + Total non-current liabilities + Total current liabilities must equal Total equity and liabilities.
Total assets must equal Total equity and liabilities.
Property, plant and equipment gross - Accumulated depreciation = Property, plant and equipment net.
